# The Human Laboratory

> Home of Calisthenics Lab India and The Yog Lab — bodyweight strength training, yoga, and kids programs in Madhapur, HITEC City, Hyderabad.

## Calisthenics Lab India

- [Calisthenics Lab India](https://the-human-laboratory.vercel.app/calisthenics-lab) — Calisthenics and bodyweight strength training academy in Madhapur, HITEC City, Hyderabad
- Programs: Weekday group coaching batches (4 morning + 4 evening), Weekend Reset batch, Personal Training, Kids Batch
- Kids program: Weekend calisthenics and gymnastics for young learners
- All levels welcome — beginners to advanced athletes
- Tagline: "By The Community, For The Community"
- Contact: +91 88267 62234 | Calisthenicslabindia@gmail.com
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/calisthenics.lab.india)
- [Google Maps](https://maps.app.goo.gl/695SVZHotKEeK4zJ7)
- Location: Madhapur, HITEC City, Hyderabad, Telangana, India

## The Yog Lab

- [The Yog Lab](https://the-human-laboratory.vercel.app/yog-lab) — Yoga and intentional movement studio co-located with Calisthenics Lab India
- Sessions on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday
- Plans: Monthly, Quarterly, Half-Yearly, Yearly
- Contact: same as above
